title: Adaptive Trust Chain (ATC): Executable Specification and Reference Smart Contract
description: Open-source executable specification for the Adaptive Trust Chain (ATC) framework, comprising: (1) WeldComplianceASC.sol — Solidity 0.8.20 Adaptive Smart Contract implementing Algorithm 1 (checkCompliance with multi-signature governed threshold updates); (2) Prototype.py — Python/NumPy ASI-PLC Monte Carlo simulation implementing Algorithm 2, reproducing all results in Section 7 of the companion paper (mean 274.0 ms, P95 320.0 ms, 486.2 ms boundary case, seed=2025); (3) Prototype_app.py — interactive Streamlit UI for exploratory analysis. This is an executable specification and design-level plausibility check, not hardware-in-the-loop validation. Latency values are drawn from assumed distributions, not measured on physical equipment. See companion paper for full evidentiary status.

notes: This release (v1.0.0) reproduces the exact quantitative results reported in Section 7 of the companion paper: mean valid latency 274.0 ms, P95 320.0 ms, timeout boundary case 486.2 ms, zero false positives (seed=2025, n=200). The Solidity contract has not been deployed, formally verified, or audited; the Python simulation uses assumed latency distributions, not physical measurements.
